physical_law_changes: None. Same nine unit-cost terms, gain cap 4, dE/dt=10*(100-E)-W.
implementation_correction: Pump is integrated from 10*(100-E), not assigned as work plus reserve change. Independent validation rebuilds physical states, event guards and W from raw inputs.
primary_comparison: gate_on versus gate_off in test: SAME normally trained checkpoint, identical initial g,b,q,E and external input/random field; only READY guard on dz is removed. b remains adaptive in both. Downstream traffic may diverge as a causal consequence.
acquisition_comparison: gate_on versus gate_off training: identical nominal initial state and external input/random field; only dz guard differs. All 20 seeds at every noisy level, plus quiet seed0.
lifecycle_comparison: normal training + gate_on test versus ungated training + trained_off test. One 2048-pulse acquisition plus one 128-pulse held-out test; includes preparation, not just use. Each test uses its own trained state.
secondary_comparison: normal_frozen versus uniform4_frozen: normal learned b matched; both z and b frozen. Static gain-assignment comparison, NOT a direct gate-effect test. No fabrication cost invented for uniform assignment.

noise.coupling: same counter-based external random field indexed by seed, layer, lane, port, stage, label and occurrence

cost_scope: Integral of W for all cells until local main/auxiliary cycles finish; includes nine terms. Excludes external source, unspecified gain manufacturing/maintenance, and idle replenishment after W reaches zero. Model work units, not SI joules.
reserve_scope: E initially100. Positive bound checked for each finite input path; refuse paths without a positive guarantee. No depletion/E=0 experiment, no general depleted-reserve solver claimed.
statistics: Paired bootstrap95% over20 network seeds,20000 resamples, deterministic RNG20261025. Quiet is one deterministic example. Show both ratio of mean costs and paired absolute difference; no pooling lanes as independent replicates. Exploratory, no multiple-comparison correction.
validation_scope: Independent Python hybrid ODE local cases, plus section identities, independently integrated pump balance, checkpoint matching, output-event recount and regressions. Not an interval proof of all trajectories.
